_about: Northstar v1 (7 Oct 2026), trained from Top-100 #2 (r14, symz.mov, podcast/motivational, score 9). A warm, tight podcast plate with stacked mixed-size captions (tiny lead words, ONE big cream bold word, an elegant serif word for the emotional beat, a handwriting phrase to close, diagonal word stairs on short asides), cut fast with cinematic stills (a starry sky, a lone figure at sunset, a dark dramatic scene) that keep the captions over them, and a light paper concept page where the key word cycles through typefaces over an engraving (brain, gears). Picture change about every second in the busiest stretches.

director.style: Northstar: a warm cinematic podcast cut. Tight warm speaker, stacked captions with one cream bold word, cinematic stills that carry the captions, and one light paper concept page. Thoughtful, emotional, premium.
director.captions: captions.heroes: a content word for nearly every phrase (never filler). captions.serif: 1-3 emotional or contrast words (second, right, truth). captions.script: ONE closing phrase in handwriting. captions.stairs: one short aside of 3 words (e.g. 'so you know', 'super fast super quick') as a diagonal staircase. Lowercase.
director.cutaways: 3-4 image scenes per 20 s on the big ideas (life, goals, growth, the future): starry night sky, a lone silhouette at sunset, mountains, a dark dramatic scene. captions: true, in: blur, 1.0-1.6 s, grade saturate(0.9) contrast(1.15) brightness(0.8). Look at every still: no disasters, no soldiers, no paintings.
director.concept: ONE concept scene per reel on the key idea word: kind concept, word = that word, engravings = 1-2 from the engraving library (brain, gears, lightbulb, rocket, moneybag, coins, robot, target, chess...), 0.9-1.4 s, step 0.22.
director.rhythm: cadence.targetPerMin 48 fills between scenes; scenes spread evenly, one every 3-4 s.
director.dont: No neon, no red, no hard flashes, no black word cards.
